# Isaiah Chapter 54 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 17 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Sing O barren one; your Maker is your husband; taught by the LORD; no weapon shall prosper*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**The Future Glory of Zion:** Sing O barren one; your Maker is your husband; taught by the LORD; no weapon shall prosper. The key message for modern readers: "No weapon that is fashioned against you shall succeed"

*-- PNEUMA*
